say:1:1030209001:0.text: My neighbor, a super cute girl.
say:1:1030209001:0.source_cn: 就是我的邻居，一位超级可爱的女孩。
say:1:1030209001:0.male: My neighbor, a super cute girl.

say:2:1030209002:0.text: We grew up together. But she's always been a bit clueless and seems not quite aware of the world around her... Still, she's very cute!
say:2:1030209002:0.source_cn: 我们两个是青梅竹马，不过她总是迷迷糊糊的，还没开窍的样...
